mode: Generation using an existing project print reference
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: full-bleed textile-pattern background for the opening section of the GREEDILOUS brand identity presentation website. Wide landscape 16:9.
Primary request: fill the entire image edge to edge with a sophisticated patterned fashion fabric in the brand's deep red key colour.
Input image role: clothing print vocabulary reference ONLY. Use its checks and rose/floral motifs as inspiration; do not depict the model, any person, the clothes as garments, or any faces/text from the collage print.
Subject and composition: an uninterrupted close-up surface of luxurious woven fashion fabric, viewed almost straight-on, with a large, orderly repeating plaid/check structure interwoven with evenly spaced graphic rose-and-leaf motifs. The repeated textile pattern should feel deliberate, distinctive and rhythmic. Pattern fills all four edges; no central hero object, no border, no empty staging. Medium-scale motifs, visible but restrained jacquard weave and fine warp/weft threads. Almost flat cloth with only very shallow broad undulations that catch the light; not piled or crumpled fabric.
Colour palette: strictly tonal reds — deep oxblood #650f1d, burgundy #490512, rich crimson #9b263b, small restrained scarlet highlights. No white, black-and-white checks, gold, blue, yellow or green. Floral shapes are also red on red. Do not include a logo or any new emblem.
Lighting: soft raking studio illumination that reveals the woven material, moderate contrast and rich dark red depth, tactile premium editorial textile photography. Even overall distribution, with no bright hotspot. Keep the bottom quarter subtly dark enough for pale overlaid website copy, but continue the pattern there.
No people, runway, silhouettes, clothing outlines, hands, bags, props, labels, typography, watermarks or UI. One cohesive fabric surface, sharp and richly detailed.
